title: Only the merge tool may post a review record
why: Third incident of a hand-written review record: lane notes-fix-reverify-large on #1494, #1506, #1597, #1667 and #1668, after #1512 and #1472.
note: Fix: the guard refuses `gh pr comment` or `gh api …/comments` whose body has the review-record header, unless the merge tool sends it. The coordinator reverses its earlier `Fix: none` (its own pick, 18:42 CST Nov 7, can be undone). The five PRs wait for #1634 and records re-posted from the tool. Same post point as step review-record-post-parses (lane session_013NEJL1rKuNDSwMxwArjXHb), which checks that a posted record parses: one guard home for both.
